Here’s what you can do to find out the match for today:

| Step | What to do | Where to look |
|------|------------|---------------|
| 1 | **Check the official IPL website** – <https://www.iplt20.com> | Home page → “Schedule” tab |
| 2 | **Open the IPL mobile app** (iOS/Android) – it shows live scores, match timings, and TV/streaming links |
| 3 | **Search on sports news sites** – ESPN Cricinfo, BBC Sport, or Cricbuzz have up‑to‑date fixtures |
| 4 | **Use a quick Google search** – type “IPL match today” or “IPL fixtures July 27 2026” |

If you let me know the season year or the teams you’re interested in, I can try to pull up the exact fixture for you.
